item.title: FAA lifts nationwide ground stop that blocked takeoffs for hours
item.description: Takeoffs from airports throughout the US largely stopped on Friday after the FAA issued a national ground stop at 3:44PM ET "due to extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety," while planes in the air will be allowed to land. The FAA tweeted just after 5PM ET that, "There has been a temporary telecommunications outage […]

item.title: The FAA Nationwide Ground Stop Is Over
item.description: The five-hour ordeal ended Friday evening. Planes will be allowed to fly again, but the effects of the stoppage will be felt throughout the weekend.

item.title: Gigabyte unveils its Nvidia Spark-powered AI workstation — AI TOP AERO combines Blackwell architecture GPU and up to 128 GB memory, if you can get one
item.description: Three days after its stated launch, the one-liter AI TOP AERO still has no price, no regional configurations and no product page.
